data_quality.notes: Gold review: Iberia is a fare-brand and route-based baggage model. Basic fares are the main no-bag exposure; included allowance is separate from paid additional bags, overweight, and irregular-shaped baggage. Online purchase can be cheaper than airport purchase, and Iberia Group or partner operation can change the controlling rule.

fees.conditions: Cabin bag and personal item are included; weight and piece rules vary by cabin and operating carrier

data_quality.notes: Iberia’s cabin allowance is generally included, but the exact weight allowance differs by cabin and Iberia Group operating carrier.

fees.conditions: Included allowance depends on fare brand, cabin, route, and whether the flight is Iberia Group-operated

data_quality.notes: Iberia is not a flat-fee model. The free allowance changes by cabin, fare brand, route, and status; Basic is the main no-bag exposure.

fees.conditions: Basic fares and extra bags are priced by route, timing, season, and purchase channel

data_quality.notes: Iberia shows additional-bag prices by itinerary rather than one universal fee; online purchase is usually the cleaner path before airport pricing applies.

fees.conditions: Iberia Club and oneworld baggage benefits depend on tier, cabin, existing allowance, and Iberia Group operation
fees.applies_to: Eligible Iberia Club and oneworld members

data_quality.notes: Iberia Plus Gold/oneworld Sapphire and higher can receive an extra 23 kg bag when allowance includes 0 or 1 checked bag.

fees.conditions: Overweight applies above 23 kg up to 32 kg; extra bags added beyond allowance may have separate limits

data_quality.notes: Iberia’s standard checked piece is 23 kg with a 32 kg hard ceiling; overweight availability and fee treatment vary by route and bag type.

fees.conditions: Sports gear may count within allowance for eligible Iberia Club tiers; otherwise special or excess-baggage rules apply

data_quality.notes: Iberia Club sports-equipment benefit does not extend to oneworld-only members; special-baggage charges can still apply otherwise.

fees.conditions: Standard checked pieces must stay within 158 linear cm; irregular-shaped baggage has separate route charges

data_quality.notes: Iberia publishes separate irregular-shaped baggage charges by route zone, so oversize exposure is not just a normal extra-bag price.

Seat selection fee on Basic fares; amount varies by route, seat type (standard, preferred, extra legroom), and timing
